{{Top|leg}}
A '''bush-blade''' was a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] used to cut through thick plants and foliage in the jungle. Bush-blades were used by individuals venturing into the jungles that surrounded [[Port Haven/Legends|Port Haven]].
